---
title: "Life Expectancy and GDP per Capita"
---

This page analyzes how life expectancy relates to GDP per capita over time using the Gapminder dataset.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

fig = px.scatter(
    df,
    x="gdp_per_capita",
    y="life_expectancy",
    color="continent",
    hover_name="country",
    animation_frame="year",
    log_x=True,
    labels={
        "gdp_per_capita": "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
        "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy (years)"
    },
    title="Life Expectancy vs GDP per Capita Over Time"
)
fig.show()

### 3.3 覆盖 `country.qmd`
```bash
cat > country.qmd <<'EOF'
---
title: "Country Analysis"
---

This page analyzes changes in life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population over time for one country.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

country_name = "China"  # change to any valid country name in the dataset
d = df[df["country"] == country_name].sort_values("year")

d_long = d.melt(
    id_vars=["year"],
    value_vars=["life_expectancy", "gdp_per_capita", "population_millions"],
    var_name="metric",
    value_name="value"
)

pretty = {
    "life_expectancy": "Life Expectancy",
    "gdp_per_capita": "GDP per Capita",
    "population_millions": "Population (millions)"
}
d_long["metric"] = d_long["metric"].map(pretty)

fig = px.line(
    d_long,
    x="year",
    y="value",
    color="metric",
    markers=True,
    title=f"{country_name}: Trends Over Time",
    labels={"year": "Year", "value": "Value", "metric": "Metric"}
)
fig.show()
cat > index.qmd <<'EOF'
---
title: "Gapminder Dataset Website"
---

Gapminder is a country-level dataset covering 142 countries from 1952 to 2007 (every 5 years) with life expectancy, population, and GDP per capita.
